name: Ray
source:
"Do not leave my side without my permission"

Race: Magician
Weapon: Rod, Spell Book.

Ray is one of the three men traveling with us.
He is a very gifted magician, come and go as he likes, without telling.
Cool and collected. He can be quite selfish sometimes.
He teases me when he is in a good mood.
While at times, he has this serious face on, and I find him mysterious.

[Official in-game description]
